audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Anivia/Anivia/Skill/Skill/Anivia/Skill/Anivia while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart are Diana on all seven rows. Also, diff said TRICKY at 7/10 with a 7.5/10 carry threat on a matchup Diana wins 55.65% of 1,159 games with every level-chart row in her favour.
audit.why: Anivia is immobile with setup-dependent CC; Diana's 900-range Q plus a Moonlight-reset dash beats her at every stage the data covers. A 7/10 difficulty label directly contradicts both the win rate and the chart.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side set to Diana; diff EVEN, diffRating 4.5/10, carryRating 6/10, tone recoloured to the EVEN swatch, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t brought into line.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and content mid both said Moonfall lets you 'dive straight through' or 'leap directly over' Crystallize. Diana's R is not a dash — Riot's text is a reveal, a draw-in and an area detonation at 475 range. Nothing in either kit supports crossing the wall with it.
audit.why: This is the level 6 spike the whole page is built on, and it was described by a mechanic Diana does not have. Lunar Rush is the dash, and the ownerKit flag itself notes walls deny it.
audit.corrected: Rewritten so the spike is the window when the flat 17s Crystallize is down, not a wall-bypass.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent. Crystallize is 'an impassable wall of ice to block all movement' on a flat 17s — it is the one thing that cuts Lunar Rush off mid-dash. And Frostbite doubles its damage only if the target 'was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm', so dodging the setup turns a 4s-cooldown nuke into chip.
audit.why: Together they are the whole lane: the wall decides whether you arrive, the Flash Frost link decides whether arriving hurts.
audit.corrected: Written into winCon, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.mid, phases[2].why, phases[3].why and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebirth was mentioned only in passing in content prose and never in the full layer — killing Anivia requires breaking a full-health egg.
audit.why: It changes every all-in calculation: your combo has to kill twice, or the kill needs a follow-up.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.carry, loading and breakdown.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Crystallize flat 17s, Flash Frost 11s->7s, Frostbite 4s, Glacial Storm 4/3/2s, Pale Cascade 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, both under unrelated titles; eleven fields called Anivia 'he'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists anivia as female, and the bullet bodies explained something other than what their titles promised.
audit.corrected: Both bullets rewritten to their own titles; every flagged pronoun fixed in the fields I edited.

Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.

edits.before: Good trade: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left. Bad trade: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Good trade: Q through the wave onto her chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade she answers after you've left. Bad trade: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Carry by killing her twice — Rebirth returns her at full health, so bring Ignite or a teammate to break the egg.

edits.before: You are the dive: E through the front line onto their carry, R the collapse, and let the resets carry you out famous.
edits.after: You are the dive: flank past the wall, E onto the Moonlight mark, R the collapse, and finish the egg before it hatches.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Time Pale Cascade so the orbs are out when Flash Frost lands — the shield eats the stun's damage and pays back three hits.

edits.before: Your W is the trade — entering without orbs is volunteering for his combo at melee range.
edits.after: Your W is the trade — entering without orbs is volunteering for her combo at melee range.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Without the Moonlight mark your E has no reset, and a 17s Crystallize can cut the dash off halfway. Land Q first.

edits.before: Moonfall lets you dive straight through her Crystallize wall — the one tool she has to stop your engage — and burst her before she can rebuild the wall.
edits.after: Moonfall arrives at 6 while Crystallize stays a flat 17s — bait the wall out, then commit in the window where Lunar Rush cannot be cut off.

edits.before: Level 6 makes this even more lopsided. Moonfall lets you leap directly over or through her Crystallize wall — the single tool she has to zone you out — and land on her before she can reposition. Her egg passive buys one extra life, but you have the sustained damage and follow-up to kill her twice in the same engage if your team helps finish it.
edits.after: Level 6 makes this even more lopsided, but not because you cross her wall — Crystallize is a flat 17s and blocks all movement, so the fight starts when it is down. Bait it out, then Q to mark, E onto the mark and Moonfall once she is inside 475. Her egg passive buys one extra life, so bring Ignite or a teammate to break it in the same engage.

notes:
CHART: all seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and packet.levelChart, which are unanimously Diana. I moved the sides onto the existing win[] values, so no paired win[N] edit was possible (before would equal after and be refused) — this closes seven cross-layer disagreements rather than creating any. phases[0..3].why rewritten in the same proposal; phases[4..6].why already described Diana winning.
DIFFICULTY: TRICKY / 7/10 / carry 7.5/10 contradicted a 55.65% win rate over 1,159 games and an all-Diana chart. Retuned to EVEN / 4.5/10 / 6/10 with tone set to the same swatch the other EVEN matchups use (#e8b84b), and breakdown.difficulty plus report[14].t brought into line so the three places do not argue.
FABRICATION REMOVED: spikes[1].text and content mid both claimed Moonfall dives through or leaps over Crystallize. Diana's R is a reveal-and-draw-in at 475 range, not a dash; Lunar Rush is the dash and the kit flag says walls deny it. Rewritten around the wall's 17s downtime instead. I deliberately did not claim the R pull drags her through the wall — whether forced movement crosses Crystallize is not decidable from the kit text.
phases[2].why on disk was garbled ('E pull joins... no —'), a template leak from another champion. Replaced.
REPORT CAP: two entries only — report[14].t (required so the rating matches breakdown.difficulty) and none else. report[0].t, report[3].t and report[4].t are still misgendered ('He'/'his') and report[1].t still carries the old wall claim; flagged for a later pass rather than exceeding the limit.
